spans.s: --a son of कपोतरोमा and father of Nala, known as Nandanodara dundubhi. M. ४४. ६२.

--Yajus-शाख; when याज्ञवल्क्य vomitted the Yajus due to a misunderstanding with his Guru, the other sages who were pupils of वैशम्पायन became transformed into तित्तिरा birds and received those portions of the Yajur- veda. Hence the name तैत्तिरीय. भा.
